title: div - Button Role
product-requirement: Screen readers should indicate elements with the role attribute as "button" are buttons
specification: When enabled, the screen reader SHOULD use the semantic document structure and ARIA markup
assertion: Test passes if the screen reader read out indicates that a focused div element with role="button" is a button
